title: 3 New JS Methods You Missed
sub: Added in ES2023-2025. Already in Node 22.
intro: 3 JavaScript methods most devs haven't noticed yet.

tricks.title: Set.union()
tricks.note: Union, intersection and difference are now built into Set (ES2025).

tricks.title: arr.toSorted()
tricks.note: Returns a sorted copy. The original array stays the same (ES2023).

tricks.title: Promise.withResolvers()
tricks.note: Get resolve() outside the Promise callback (ES2024).

caption:
3 JavaScript methods most devs haven't noticed yet.

Set.union() and friends for set math (ES2025)
arr.toSorted() for sorting without mutation (ES2023)
Promise.withResolvers() for cleaner async code (ES2024)

All work in Node 22+ and current browsers.

Which one will you use first?
